svg.text: Build a neon hoverboard in Roblox Studio — model it,
add a light trail, then scaffold a playable race.
Done — NeonHoverboard is in Workspace with a cyan trail, two lit thrusters and a
three-lap race at Workspace.RaceCourse. Press Play to test: LapService scores each
checkpoint, and the board respawns if it flips.
2 MCP servers connected — Blender (14 tools), Roblox Studio (8 tools)
Now animate the rig so it leans into turns
and add a second colour for boosts
Keys and history stay in this browser; hosted calls go direct or through a proxy you configure.
